view.note: Estimated occupancy is the share of rooms visible on Booking that are no longer for sale. Figures only appear when Booking reveals enough (at least half the rooms known for certain); direct bookings, groups and rooms not sold on Booking can't be seen.
view.suggestionsDescription: Based on fixed rules, with the figures behind each one. The system never changes your rates; click “Mark as applied” to record it.
view.suggestionsEmptyBody: Suggestions appear when you're below the median while the market is tight, above it while the market is selling well, or well above it close to arrival when the market isn't tight.
view.nightsDescription: Market = median of competitors with full counts on Booking. Pace compares against the same weekday 1–8 weeks earlier, at the same number of days before arrival.
view.noEstimates: No estimates for these nights yet. Estimates are calculated a few minutes after each scan finishes.
